creator: opichillc
title: One CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rule to stop stale package versions: 'Never assume package or module versions before adding a dependency. Look up the current version with npm view or check the official documentation.'

tools.name: CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
tools.detail: Instruction file for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex

tools.name: npm view
tools.detail: Queries the live npm registry for the current version in ~2 seconds

claims: Every AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) picks package versions from training data that ended months ago
The one-line rule turns the model's assumption into a registry lookup; npm view returns today's version in about two seconds
Peer-dependency warnings shrink on the next install
how_to_steps: Open CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md (or your tool's instruction file)
Add: 'Never assume package or module versions before adding a dependency. Look up the current version with `npm view` or check the official documentation.'
Run your next install and watch peer dependency warnings drop
on_screen_only: Checkbox card with the exact rule text: 'Never assume package or module versions before adding a dependency. Look up the current version with `npm view` or check the official documentation.'
cta: Save, follow; DM or book a call via link in bio for CLAUDE.md help

relevance.why: Directly fixes a recurring time sink (stale deps, peer-dep hell) for a solo founder shipping Node/React apps with Claude Code.

implement_score.why: One line in every project's CLAUDE.md, zero cost, immediate. Generalize for Python (pip index versions / pypi) and Swift packages.

verify: Does Claude Code reliably obey the rule, or does it still hard-code versions in package.json edits? Spot-check on a fresh install
Equivalent commands for other ecosystems (pip index versions, cargo search, swift package)

gap.what: New technique: an explicit CLAUDE.md rule forcing live version lookup before adding dependencies. Liked set covered thin CLAUDE.md and Karpathy critiques but not dependency-version staleness.
